topic: Testing new release and data access
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered testing a new software release (v24.7.3.42-stable) on the sandbox environment, with plans to move it to production in a couple of weeks after configuration adjustments.

A key discussion point was making a 'superset' visible to sales personnel who lack VPN access, requiring deployment to superset.allunite.com while maintaining strict access restrictions.

Later, issues were reported regarding the 'clickhouse-odbc-bridge,' which failed to connect or start on both servers. A test query (`select * from facility_dict;`) was provided for verification.
decisions: The new release (v24.7.3.42-stable) will be tested in the sandbox environment first, followed by production deployment in a couple of weeks.
action_items: [p1] to check on the clickhouse bridge connection when at home.
